lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Hello, Mike!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.en: Hi, Sam! How are you?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Fine, thanks. And you?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.en: I'm okay, thanks. This is Helen. She's a friend from work.

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.en: Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Hi! Nice to meet you, too!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.en: Sorry, we're in a hurry. See you soon. Bye!

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Bye!

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: Hello! Is this your first time here?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: Yes, it is. Do you live near here?

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: No, I live in the center. Oh, nice. How do you want your hair?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: I don't know. Something different.

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: Do you want a coffee?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: No, thanks! I don't drink coffee.

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: Do you want a magazine?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: Yes, please. Do you have children?

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: Yes, I do. I have two boys.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: How old are they?

lines.speaker: Hairdresser
lines.en: Eight and ten. ... It's very short.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.en: Don't worry. Wait. Do you like it?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: Excuse me. You can't park there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: No? Why not?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: You're on a double yellow line!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Oh, I'm sorry, officer. Where can I park near here?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.en: You can park over there, madam, in the car park.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Thank you, officer.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: Hi, Ellie! Who's that?

lines.speaker: Ellie
lines.en: It's me, Ellie! How are you?

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: Oh, fine, thanks!

lines.speaker: Ellie
lines.en: Can you come to dinner on Friday?

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: On Friday? Oh, I'm really sorry. I can't come. It's my girlfriend's birthday.

lines.speaker: Ellie
lines.en: Your girlfriend?!

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: Yes, Lucy, from work.

lines.speaker: Ellie
lines.en: Oh, Lucy. Sorry about the dinner.

lines.speaker: Matt
lines.en: That's OK. Bye!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you like shopping?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, I don't. I hate it. I prefer cooking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Really? I love shopping! I enjoy buying clothes and music.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I don't like clothes shopping. But I like buying food.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What do you like doing at the weekend, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I like cooking, reading, and playing chess with my friends.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Hi, darling.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Oh hi, Dad. How's Paris?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Fine. A lot of work. Did you have a good day?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: It was OK.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: What did you do?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: I got up early. I went to school.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: How was it?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Great! We didn't have classes. We went to the museum.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Oh nice. Did you have lunch there?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Yes, we had lunch at the cafe. And then I went shopping.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.en: Did you do your homework?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Yes, of course. I always do my homework.

lines.speaker: Inspector
lines.en: What did you do after dinner yesterday evening?

lines.speaker: Barbara
lines.en: After dinner I played cards with Gordon, and then I went to bed.

lines.speaker: Inspector
lines.en: What time was that?

lines.speaker: Barbara
lines.en: It was about half past eleven. I remember I looked at my watch.

lines.speaker: Inspector
lines.en: Did you hear anything in your father's room?

lines.speaker: Barbara
lines.en: No, I didn't hear anything.

lines.speaker: Inspector
lines.en: Did you have any problems with your father?

lines.speaker: Barbara
lines.en: No, no problems at all. My father was a wonderful man.

lines.speaker: Inspector
lines.en: Thank you, Ms Travers.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: Hello! We have a reservation.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Let's see. Yes. Welcome to the island. Your room's upstairs, number seven.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: Is there a lift?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: No, I'm sorry. There isn't. But I can help you with your bags. This is your room.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: It's very small.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: Yes, but there's a beautiful view.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: There are two beds. We wanted a double bed.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: This is the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: There isn't a bath!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: No, there's a shower. It uses less water.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.en: Are there any shops near here?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.en: No. There aren't.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Excuse me, can I sit here?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Sure.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I loved that book.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Sorry?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I said I loved that book.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Coffee?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: Okay.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: What do you do?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: I work for a bank. What do you do?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: I work in property. Flats and houses.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.en: That's interesting! Do you live in London?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.en: Yes. I have a flat near the river.
